The *Mahākaccāyanattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 533) is a canonical verse text belonging to the *Therāpadāna* collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. It commemorates the biographical and karmic background of the prominent elder Mahākaccāyana, chronicling his pious deeds and meritorious offerings in previous lives that culminated in his realization of awakening under the Buddha [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records translations of the poem into five modern languages [SuttaCentral].
